recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見多個一端拉長成尾巴的淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocyte），並有紅血球大小不一，這是原發性骨髓纖維化（agnogenic myeloid metaplasia）的典型周邊血表現。
features: Several teardrop-shaped red cells (dacrocytes) with single tapered tails
Rare red cell with a small basophilic inclusion
No nucleated cells in this field; red cell overlap in thicker areas
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with several teardrop cells (dacrocytes) bearing single tapered tails and occasional ovalocytes. A rare red cell contains a small basophilic inclusion, and small platelets are scattered. No nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes are present in this field. Findings are consistent with teardrop poikilocytosis as seen in primary myelofibrosis; evaluation of the leukoerythroblastic picture, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation status and bone marrow biopsy with reticulin stain is recommended.

ddx.dx: Myelophthisis (metastatic tumor or granulomatous marrow infiltration)
ddx.vs: Myelophthisic anemia produces identical teardrop cells and a leukoerythroblastic smear, so separation requires marrow biopsy showing infiltrating tumor or granulomas rather than MPN fibrosis.
Thalassemia may show teardrop cells but is accompanied by marked microcytosis, target cells and basophilic stippling.
Artifactual teardrops have tails pointing in the same direction in one area of the smear, whereas true dacrocytes have randomly oriented tails.
